purpose: Determine whether an authoritative public marine acoustic/geophysical survey footprint, multibeam swath, ping-file geometry, side-scan/subbottom line, or seismic track directly intersects the frozen LOVE-EDEM ocean point, without recentering or admitting cruise bounding boxes as local evidence.

coverage_admission_tiers.TIER_B_NEAR_LOCAL_NOT_EXACT: centerline or station lies within a separately preregistered small radius but its measured footprint is not shown to contain the frozen point
coverage_admission_tiers.TIER_C_REGIONAL_CONTROL: regional cruise, survey, CTD, seismic context or broad bounding box without local intersection proof

M121_GA08.note: Raw EM122 data remain scientifically useful but the documented 3S transect does not intersect the frozen point.

broad_open_web_and_literature_search.important_boundary: This is not equivalent to proving that no public local dataset exists.

legacy_angola_brazil_geotraverse.reason: Published descriptions place the main Angola-Brazil Geotraverse near 12 S, far south of the frozen point; it remains geological/seismoacoustic background only.

authoritative_exact_query_routes_identif.capability: supports spatial query and query-with-distance against authoritative survey trackline geometry

authoritative_exact_query_routes_identif.service: next-catalogs multibeam catalog and ArcGIS multibeam datasets/files
authoritative_exact_query_routes_identif.capability: geometry bounding-box filters for surveys and file-specific geometries; raw/processed/product layers exposed separately
polygons represent curated multibeam coverage based on swath-file extent at approximately 100 m synthesis resolution
masked ocean grid contains only curated high-resolution data and NaN where high-resolution data do not exist

regional_geological_context.context: The central Angola Basin is an abyssal plain with comparatively subdued acoustic-basement relief; historical seismic work exists regionally, but regional geology does not substitute for an intersecting local survey line.

why_not_NOT_FOUND_yet: The authoritative NCEI and GMRT spatial-index/coverage services have been identified, but their exact point-intersection outputs have not yet been successfully extracted in this execution. Failure of a text/web search is not evidence of archive absence.
